name: Fair-Value-Gap Retest Continuation
hypothesis: First retest of an unfilled three-candle M15 imbalance left by a >=1 ATR displacement, rejected in the H1 EMA-trend direction, resumes the displacement.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop beyond the far side of the gap plus 0.25 M15 ATR; 2.5R objective; exit by min(8h, next broker gap).
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
